discrepancy_leads: The paper is not public (under review, no arXiv/DOI): every per-arm target comes from the deposit's own per-cell-counts-v2.csv/README, so an L2 'paper gap' can only be a deposit-internal inconsistency or a mapping error.
16 x 8 map vs deposit: gemini-3.1-pro-preview has no T-MCPDESC cell (and no TDELAY cell); either Table 3 has an empty cell or a cell is missing from the deposit.

Model directory vs model field: the addendum Claude T-WEB cells sit in dirs claude-opus-4-7/claude-opus-4-8/claude-sonnet-4-6 beside opus-4-7/opus-4-8/sonnet-4-6; the excluded fable-5 dir holds eu.anthropic.claude-fable-5. With 21 strings in all (census), at least the three addendum cells must carry the roster strings; arms keyed by directory and by field may differ.

Superseded and repeated waves: the Devstral T-WEB 20-run pilot is still deposited although the N=100 wave is reported in place of it; other (model, channel) pairs have 2-8 cells (T-WEB addendum waves, sonnet-4-6 T1 x8). Pooling by arm without the README's table map would not reproduce the paper's rates; rates.toml has no rule for superseded pilots.

Two run schemas (3,686 newer-schema runs with taskEngaged/t0Completed/truncated/invocationError) and project prefixes p14/p15b: runs from several harness builds pooled in one deposit; the harness is not identified in the data.
